ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: GCF/ACQ/DL/40/LR. Land Ministry Ref. No.: LD/05/2005/LRB/263. I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government has acquired the below mentioned land to develop the drainage system at Aththidiya Wewa road under Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Improvement Project: Desription of the land to be acquired:

An allotment of land in total extent of 0.0147 hectare depicted as lot number 01 in the preliminary plan no. 9366 dated 04.07.2013 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Village called Aththidiya in the Grama Niladhari Division of Aththidiya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dehiwala in Colombo District of the Western province and bounded as follows. 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Aththidiya Paddy field; Description: Cement drain; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0147 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 13.03.2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 06.03.2024 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.

gfg H. THILAKAWARDHANA, Acquiring Officer, Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environmental Improvement Project, Divisional Secretary’s Division - Dehiwala. Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environmental Improvement Project. No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya 16.01.2024
